title: Different roles may experience trust differently
description: Trust levels appear to vary between roles involved in the delivery system.
recommendation: It may be helpful to explore how trust is experienced across the team and leadership.

title: Ownership expectations may differ between roles
description: Roles appear to have different perspectives on where ownership sits.
recommendation: Discuss how responsibility for outcomes is shared across the delivery system.

title: Learning capability may be limited
description: The organisation may have limited mechanisms for learning from delivery experience.
recommendation: Consider how teams capture insights and improve their ways of working.

title: Trust may be a constraint in the system
description: Lower trust levels may be affecting collaboration or openness within the system.
recommendation: Explore how psychological safety and trust are supported across the team.

title: System thinking may differ across roles
description: Some roles may see the delivery system more broadly than others.
recommendation: Discuss how different roles understand the wider delivery system.

title: Delivery capability may be outpacing learning capability
description: Delivery outcomes may be prioritised more strongly than organisational learning.
recommendation: Explore how teams reflect on their work and evolve their practices.
